norm: memif functions as a stateless mediation layer for job invocations without own data buffering
assumption: MemIf functions as a stateless mediation layer for job invocations without own data buffering.
rationale: SWS_MemIf specifies synchronous forwarding to submodules based on DeviceIndex without intermediate buffering.
